Step 1: Determine UTC offsets.  
US/Eastern = UTC-5 (standard time).  
US/Mountain = UTC-7 (standard time).  

Step 2: Convert 10 PM (22:00) Eastern to UTC.  
UTC = 22:00 + 5 = 03:00 next day (July 8, 1249).  

Step 3: Convert UTC to Mountain time.  
Mountain = 03:00 - 7 = 20:00 previous day (July 7, 1249).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 20:00
